from pathlib import Path
from mathutils import Vector
mod=bpy.app.driver_namespace['mad_slime_builder']
bpy.ops.object.select_all(action='SELECT');bpy.ops.object.delete(use_global=False)
for i,name in enumerate(mod.BUILDERS):
    path=mod.SOURCE/'Blender'/(name+'.blend')
    with bpy.data.libraries.load(str(path),link=False) as (src,dst):dst.objects=[name]
    obj=dst.objects[0];bpy.context.collection.objects.link(obj)
    obj.location=((i%4-1.5)*1.7,(2-i//4)*1.7,.5)
    obj.rotation_euler[2]=-.2
    obj.select_set(False)
scene=bpy.context.scene
cam=mod.camera_at('Collection camera',(2,-10,9),(0,1.7,.5));cam.data.ortho_scale=8.0;scene.camera=cam
scene.render.engine='CYCLES';scene.cycles.samples=32
scene.render.resolution_x=1600;scene.render.resolution_y=1200;scene.render.resolution_percentage=100
scene.world.color=(.3,.3,.3);scene.view_settings.view_transform='Standard';scene.render.film_transparent=True
for p,power,size in [((-3,-4,7),1500,7),((5,-1,4),700,5),((0,6,7),1300,6)]:
    bpy.ops.object.light_add(type='AREA',location=p);o=bpy.context.object;o.data.energy=power;o.data.size=size;o.rotation_euler=(Vector((0,2,.5))-o.location).to_track_quat('-Z','Y').to_euler()
for screen in bpy.data.screens:
    for area in screen.areas:
        if area.type=='VIEW_3D':
            area.spaces.active.region_3d.view_perspective='CAMERA'
            area.spaces.active.shading.type='MATERIAL'
bpy.ops.wm.save_as_mainfile(filepath=str(mod.SOURCE/'MadSlime-Skins.blend'))
scene.render.filepath=str(mod.SOURCE/'collection.png');bpy.ops.render.render(write_still=True)
print('MCP_COLLECTION_READY',len([o for o in scene.objects if o.type=='MESH']))
